about: Symbols of Foundation and of the Swift libraries of the system that the built application may import weakly: the ones it imported when this list was made, all of them present in every released macOS that reports the version their call is guarded by. tests/test-weak-system-imports.py refuses any other, and names the ones in "refused" with their reason. A new entry needs the same check: the symbol's availability in the SDK is a released system version, and no system that reports that version lacks it.
